_note: Which product line a signal LEADS on. By default ingest.py takes the first category in product_map.json that matched, so a row is filed under whichever category the reference file happens to list first — atm_recycling — regardless of what the row is actually about. That is a systemic bias, not a per-row mistake; until it is fixed at the ranking level, this file re-files the rows where it produces a plainly wrong lead. Key = the signal's slug (its bank_theme slugified, as it appears in dashboard-data.json). The named product must already be among the row's matched products; ingest.py warns and ignores the entry otherwise.
